topics.title: 课程作业
topics.statusLabel: 限范围公开依据；现行性待复核
topics.summary: Penn State 部分课程或任务允许使用 AI，另一些不允许；即使工具经大学批准，学术诚信政策仍适用。
topics.scope: Penn State 学生使用 AI 须按课程及作业说明判断；ORP 研究责任、AI Studio 数据规则、无障碍审核与 AI 辅助评分审批各有不同对象。

claims.text: Penn State's Academic Integrity page makes student use of content-generating AI tools course- and assignment-specific and warns that improper use can be an academic integrity violation.

evidence.quote: In some classes, students may use AI tools. In some classes, students may not use AI tools. And in some classes, students may use AI tools for some, but not all, assignments or tasks. This applies to the use of all content-generating AI tools... The improper use of these tools can be an academic integrity violation.
evidence.title: Artificial Intelligence | Academic Integrity

claims.text: Penn State says academic integrity policies apply to student use or misuse of all tools, including university-approved AI tools.

evidence.quote: For students, academic integrity policies apply to the use or misuse of all tools, including those that are: university-approved, publicly available, offered by subscription, or purchased.
evidence.title: FAQs - AI at Penn State

topics.title: 使用披露
topics.statusLabel: 限范围公开依据；现行性待复核
topics.summary: Penn State ORP 研究指引要求记录输入、输出和提示词，核实生成内容，并在研究成果中透明披露使用；这不是适用于所有课程作业的统一格式。
topics.scope: Penn State 学生使用 AI 须按课程及作业说明判断；ORP 研究责任、AI Studio 数据规则、无障碍审核与 AI 辅助评分审批各有不同对象。

claims.text: Penn State ORP guidance says researchers using generative AI must document process inputs, outputs, and prompts, verify AI-generated content, data, and references, and disclose use transparently in proposals, manuscripts, and publications.

evidence.quote: Core responsibility include: Documenting research processes including inputs, outputs, and AI prompts. Taking primary responsibility for verifying all AI-generated content, data, and references. Disclosing use transparently in proposals, manuscripts, and publications.

topics.title: 隐私与数据
topics.statusLabel: 限范围公开依据；现行性待复核
topics.summary: AI Studio 允许输入第 1–2 级数据，禁止第 3–4 级；Penn State 另有指引禁止向任何 AI 工具输入第 3–4 级信息，人体受试者研究还须满足 IRB 与数据协议条件。
topics.scope: Penn State 学生使用 AI 须按课程及作业说明判断；ORP 研究责任、AI Studio 数据规则、无障碍审核与 AI 辅助评分审批各有不同对象。

claims.text: Penn State's AI Studio user agreement permits Level 1 and Level 2 data in AI Studio and prohibits Level 3 and Level 4 data.

evidence.quote: Level 1 (Low) and Level 2 (Moderate) data may be entered into AI Studio. Users must not enter Level 3 (High) or Level 4 (Restricted) data into AI Studio.
evidence.location: User Agreement - Permitted Data and Prohibited Data
evidence.title: AI Studio - AI at Penn State

claims.text: Penn State guidance tells users not to use free personal AI accounts for Penn State-related teaching, learning, research, or work and never to input Level 3 or Level 4 information into any AI tool.

evidence.quote: Do not use free personal AI accounts for Penn State-related teaching, learning, research, or work. Never input Level 3 or Level 4 information into any AI tool, including University-provided tools.
evidence.title: Data Protection - AI at Penn State

claims.text: Penn State ORP guidance says identifiable or restricted human-subjects data should not be input into generative AI systems unless IRB and data agreements explicitly approve it.

evidence.quote: Do not input identifiable or "restricted" data into generative AI systems unless explicitly approved by IRB and data agreements.
evidence.location: Generative AI and Human Subjects Research - Deidentification and Privacy
evidence.title: Generative AI in Research - Research Support
